title: Guidance – Agentic Field Technician Assistant
tools: AI Agents (Google Gemini) · Application Development (Python, React)
blurb: 1st of 20 teams at BeaverHacks 2026: a Gemini agent that answers a technician's photo-and-voice questions and draws the next step on the image.
long: Built the end-to-end solution in 24 hours with a team at BeaverHacks 2026, and won 1st place in the beginner track of 20 teams.

A technician captures photos from a laptop webcam or a paired phone, then asks a question by voice or text. A multi-stage Gemini pipeline transcribes the audio, analyzes the images, answers in spoken guidance, edits the photo into an annotated diagram of the next action, and reads the answer aloud.
The agent retrieves machine manuals locally by RAG through function calling, scoped by the QR code on each machine, and keeps task state so it remembers what has already been tried.
highlights: Image + audio input, spoken output, annotated diagrams
